resources.name: Omron Management
resources.description: Backend API for the Omron weight control system. See backend/AGENTS.md for the architecture and docs/schema.dbml for the data model.

resources.name: Skinfold Sites
resources.description: CRUD for the SkinfoldSite reference table. All endpoints require auth:sanctum (Bearer token). Set the `token` env var to a Sanctum-issued personal access token. Authz: viewAny/view are open to any authenticated user (reference data is read often from forms); create/update require admin/super-admin; delete requires super-admin only.

resources.name: List Skinfold Sites
resources.description: GET /api/skinfold-sites — paginated list with filters. Query params (all optional): per_page (int 1..100, default 25), page (int >=1, default 1), code (string, ilike %term%), name (string, ilike %term%). Results are ordered by `code` ascending (reference data, not by date). Filters AND together. Open to any authenticated user.

resources.name: Create Skinfold Site
resources.description: POST /api/skinfold-sites — body fields: code (string, required, max 50, must be unique), name (string, required, max 255). Returns 422 on duplicate code or validation failure. Requires `create` policy (admin/super-admin).

resources.name: Show Skinfold Site
resources.description: GET /api/skinfold-sites/{skinfold_site} — returns the site. Path: set `skinfold_site_id` env var or replace `{skinfold_site_id}` in the URL. Soft-deleted sites return 404. Open to any authenticated user.

resources.name: Update Skinfold Site
resources.description: PUT/PATCH /api/skinfold-sites/{skinfold_site} — all body fields optional (`sometimes`). On code change, the unique check excludes the current site (so you can re-send the same code without conflict). Soft-deleted sites return 404. Requires `update` policy (admin/super-admin).

resources.name: Delete Skinfold Site
resources.description: DELETE /api/skinfold-sites/{skinfold_site} — soft delete (sets `deleted_at`). The site stays in the DB but is hidden by the SoftDeletes global scope. WARNING: this resource is referenced by `skinfold_measurement_details.skinfold_site_id` with `restrictOnDelete`; soft delete is safe, but a hard delete (forceDelete in tinker) will fail. Requires `delete` policy (super-admin only — admins are denied).
